description: Find, connect, rediscover your notes — a local-first second brain for Obsidian. Semantic search with strong Chinese/CJK, relation graphs and semantic paths for connections you never drew, Hot/Cold rediscovery of forgotten notes. Desktop builds the index; phones and tablets search it. No API keys.
